jobs.company: Redlands Conservatory of Music, Film, and Dance
jobs.title: Private Music Teacher
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**  
The Redlands Conservatory of Music is seeking a passionate and dedicated Music Teacher to join our education team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in piano instruction and a love for teaching students of all ages.

This role involves creating engaging lesson plans, fostering a positive learning environment, and helping students develop their musical skills and appreciation for music.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement individualized lesson plans tailored to each student's skill level and musical interests.
* Teach piano techniques, music theory, and performance skills in a structured manner.
* Assess student progress regularly and provide constructive feedback to enhance their learning experience.
* Create a supportive and encouraging atmosphere that fosters student confidence and creativity.
* Organize recitals or performances to showcase student achievements and promote community engagement.
* Collaborate with other instructors to integrate interdisciplinary approaches, such as incorporating elements of ballet, theater, or early childhood education into lessons when appropriate.
* Maintain open communication with students and their families regarding progress and areas for improvement.

**Skills**

* Bachelors in music (preferred but not required)
* Proficiency in piano performance and teaching methods.
* Strong organizational skills for lesson planning and classroom management.
* Ability to educate students effectively while adapting teaching styles to meet diverse learning needs.
* Experience in tutoring or providing childcare can be beneficial for understanding student dynamics.
* Knowledge of related arts such as ballet, theater, or sewing can enhance the educational experience offered to students.
* Excellent communication skills to build rapport with students, parents, and colleagues.
* A passion for music education and a commitment to fostering a love of music in students of all ages.
* Must live close to Redlands, California

Join us in inspiring the next generation of musicians through engaging piano instruction!

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $20\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
